Structured Execution

From Site Audit to Grid Activation in 6 Steps

Clear milestones, written Bill of Materials, and zero hidden charges from first visit to final commissioning.

STEP 01

Free Site & Load Audit

We inspect roof orientation, structural strength, shade obstructions, and your past 12-month DISCOM electricity bills.

STEP 02

Engineering & Transparent BoM

Receive a detailed layout, exact module & inverter make/model, mounting specification, and itemized quotation.

STEP 03

DISCOM & Subsidy Filing

We submit feasibility applications with PGVCL / Gujarat DISCOMs and register residential projects on PM Surya Ghar.

STEP 04

Tier-1 Procurement

ALMM-approved modules, certified string inverters, hot-dip galvanized structures, and UV-protected DC cabling delivered to site.

STEP 05

IS/IEC Installation & Testing

Trained technicians execute mechanical mounting, AC/DC safety protection, earthing, lightning arrestor, and insulation testing.

STEP 06

Net-Metering & Handover

DISCOM inspection, bi-directional meter installation, monitoring app setup, warranty documentation, and ongoing support.

Clear Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Sudarshan Solar is headquartered in Rajkot, Gujarat (360490) and executes residential, commercial, and industrial solar EPC projects across Rajkot, Morbi, Jamnagar, Wankaner, Junagadh, Ahmedabad, Surat, and all Gujarat DISCOM circles (PGVCL, UGVCL, MGVCL, DGVCL).
Under the Government of India's PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, eligible households receive ₹30,000 for a 1 kW system, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW or larger rooftop installations using DCR/ALMM-compliant panels. The subsidy is transferred directly to the consumer's bank account after net-metering and DISCOM commissioning.
Our engineer evaluates your shadow-free roof area, structural readiness, sanctioned load, and electricity bill history, then prepares a clear capacity recommendation, equipment Bill of Materials, and subsidy/net-metering timeline with zero obligation.
PM Surya Ghar capital subsidy applies to residential connections and housing societies. Commercial and industrial consumers instead benefit from Accelerated Depreciation tax savings and lower per-unit daytime power costs under Gujarat's net-metering or gross/captive frameworks.
